source_audit.title: UNESCO — Universal Declaration on the Human Genome and Human Rights
claim_scope: The declaration states that human dignity and rights are not determined by genetic characteristics and that people should not be reduced to those characteristics.
The declaration describes how genetic characteristics can be expressed differently in relation to natural and social environments.
The declaration includes consent, confidentiality and human-rights principles for genome-related research.
limitations: International declaration, not a substitute for Bangladesh law or a complete biology textbook.
Use as an ethical framework; do not treat it as evidence for specific biological claims or as individual medical advice.
source_audit.reuse_note: UNESCO declaration text; check UNESCO terms before reproducing.
